title: Flea treatment
subtitle: Draft. Only what is already written down is here. Questions for Mitch are at the bottom.
source: LPC Tech Onboarding Pack (PPE, never list, what you can quote, certificate note); jobbook-data/chemicals.json (Flea Treatment products); jobbook-data/services.json (past wordings); past inspection report wording in the treatment history

sections.heading: When this job comes up
body: Fleas in a home, including end of lease flea treatments. Mitch's service is called Flea Treatment. Past invoices read: "Flea Treatment", "End of lease flea treatment" and "Flea treatment end of lease internal & external".
The onboarding pack lists a certificate with small and end of lease flea jobs. [Mitch to confirm: what the certificate is, who issues it, and when you give one]
Once you are experienced you can quote flea jobs. Anything complex goes to Mitch.
The job process, the never list, PPE and the free service period are in the Every job guide. [Mitch to confirm: does the free service period apply to this job?]

sections.heading: PPE
sections.title: PPE on before you go in
sections.note: Never apply chemicals without PPE. If the SDS requires it, you wear it. No exceptions.
items: Gloves and closed shoes at minimum
Gloves, mask and eye protection for any spray, as per the product SDS

items.text: Subfloor entry: coveralls, gloves, dust mask, torch

sections.heading: Products Mitch uses
sections.title: Names as in Mitch's product list. No rates here: follow the label. [Mitch to confirm: which product goes inside, outside and in the subfloor]
rows: Country Bifenthrin 100 Low Odour Termiticide & Insecticide

sections.heading: Where past jobs and reports point to
rows: One end of lease invoice reads "internal & external". [Mitch to confirm: is that every end of lease job?]
A past inspection report noted a heavy flea infestation here and said it should be treated.

sections.heading: Steps
sections.title: Steps
sections.note: Only what is already written down. Anything missing is in the questions at the bottom.
items: Ask the customer to point out where the fleas are, and where pets spend time
Take BEFORE photos of the problem areas

items.text: Treat the areas booked: inside, outside, or both
items.detail: [Mitch to confirm: what you treat inside, outside and under the house, and how]

items.text: Apply per the product label. Never exceed label rates
items.detail: Never mix chemicals without checking the label first. If in doubt, call Mitch.

items: Keep chemicals away from food, children and pets
Note anything you could not treat or reach, and why
Take AFTER photos

items.text: End of lease: give the certificate
items.detail: [Mitch to confirm: what it is and where you make it]

sections.heading: Job complete when
items: BEFORE and AFTER photos taken
Areas booked have been treated, or noted with the reason they were not
Anything you could not treat or reach is noted on the job report, with the reason
Product, rate, area and quantity recorded on the job report
Customer told what you did and what to expect [Mitch to confirm: what to tell them for this pest]
Customer given the re-entry time [Mitch to confirm: same as Every job (1 to 2 hours once dry) for this job?]
Service report left, or customer told it is being emailed

sections.heading: Tell Mitch straight away if
sections.body: Call Mitch on 0432 181 689. After hours or urgent, call Mitch directly.

items.detail: Stop immediately. Do not continue. Call Mitch.
Follow the SDS procedure. Call Mitch immediately. Never leave a spill unattended.
Treat the injury first. Call Mitch. Write down what happened.

items.text: The customer complains or gets aggressive
items.detail: Stay calm and do not argue. For a complaint, tell them Mitch will call them today. If they are aggressive, remove yourself. Call Mitch either way.

items.text: The customer asks for a quote on anything complex, or you are not sure
items.detail: Say "I'll need to get Mitch to come and have a look and provide a quote for that."

items.text: You see signs of termites or other pests outside this job
items.detail: Photograph it and tell Mitch. Termite quotes always go to Mitch.

sections.heading: Mitch to fill in
sections.title: Answer each in one line and this guide is done
items: 1. What do you ask the customer first (pets, where they sleep, last treatment, vacuumed)?
2. What must the customer do before you arrive (vacuum, wash pet bedding, lift items, move pets out)?
3. Which product goes where: bifenthrin spray (Country Bifenthrin or Aquastar) or Coopex dust?
4. Which surfaces inside do you treat (carpet, bedding, skirting, under furniture)?
5. Do you treat the subfloor and the perimeter every time?
6. How long before the customer can go back in, and when can pets come back?
7. What do you tell them about vacuuming and mopping after?
8. How long until the fleas stop, and when is a second treatment needed?
9. End of lease: what is in the certificate, who gets it, and what do agents need?
10. Do you inspect first to confirm it is fleas?
11. What do customers ask most, and what do you tell them?
